{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Marut''''' was a [[Victory II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory II''-class Star Destroyer]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] fleet. It was used to raid [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] training facilities before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].
